audit.whatIsWrong: The single defining interaction in this matchup — Frostbite deals DOUBLE damage to a target recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm — appeared nowhere except one half-sentence in a cooldown bullet.
audit.why: Riot text on E: 'If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.' Sidestepping the 1075-range Flash Frost removes her entire burst, and her Frostbite is only a 4s cooldown, so the cooldown you play around is Q, never E.
audit.corrected: Stated across breakdown.cooldowns, early, whys[3], wants.you[1] and report[5].t: sidestep Flash Frost and Frostbite cannot double for the next 11 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly claimed Anivia 'has no Wall' at levels 2, 4 and 5, and spoke of 'full Wall access' as a late unlock.
audit.why: Crystallize is a normal W, available from level 2 and on a flat 17s cooldown at every rank. It does not unlock late — what changes is her mana and item support.
audit.corrected: Rewrote to the real gate: Crystallize is a flat 17s, so the window is after it is SPENT, not before she 'has' it.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie/Anivia/Anivia.
audit.why: Same level-chart row rendered twice with different answers on every row. 54.92% at 590 games supports the content version.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides flipped, ratings re-scaled 6/6/7/7/7/4/4, and each why rewritten so the prose matches the side it sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anivia was 'he/him/his' in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[2].d and report[11].t.
audit.why: Anivia is female; and the difficulty is a 1075-vs-625 range gap plus a 17s wall against a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and the range gap named explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' after a missed Flash Frost, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all — the packet defect says there is no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on this matchup.
audit.why: Flash Frost is 11/10/9/8/7s, Crystallize a flat 17s, Frostbite 4s, Glacial Storm 4/3/2s.
audit.corrected: Every window is now numbered, and the sequencing rule is explicit: commit in the eleven seconds after Flash Frost misses.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebirth barely featured — spikes[1].text said it 'doesn't matter much on tempo' and mid called the egg a delay.
audit.why: Rebirth reverts her to an egg and reborn at full health. Any kill you do not finish on the egg is not a kill, which directly changes Ignite value and where Tibbers should stand.
audit.corrected: Egg handling now appears in breakdown.carry, breakdown.mid, ahead, phases[4].why, whys[4], early and spikes[1..3].

notes: Two structural errors. (1) The page never stated the interaction the whole matchup turns on: Frostbite doubles only against a target recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm. Every 'wait for X' line now keys off Flash Frost's 11s, which also clears the packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. (2) Content asserted Anivia 'has no Wall' at levels 2, 4 and 5 and treated Crystallize as a late unlock; it is a normal W on a flat 17s from level 2, so the window is after it is spent, not before she owns it. Also: Anivia was 'he' in six fields, and dosFull[2].d promised a fifteen-second window off a spell that is 11s. Rebirth was under-weighted throughout — a kill you do not finish on the egg is not a kill, which is now reflected in Ignite advice and Tibbers placement. breakdown.wave and dontsFull[1].d remain templated.
